forum.notice_pending: Thanks for signing up! An admin needs to approve your account before you can post. We'll email you as soon as that happens.
forum.notice_declined: Your account was not approved, so it can't be used on this forum.
forum.notification: {name} signed up and is waiting for your approval

queue.empty_approved: Nobody has been approved through Gatehouse yet.

admin.enabled_help: Existing members are never affected. Admins adding members by hand are never held.
admin.allow_help: One per line. A domain (uni-freiburg.de, which includes its subdomains), an exact domain (@staff.example.org), an ending (.edu), a wildcard (*@example.com) or a regular expression between slashes. Everyone else waits. Leave it empty to approve every new member by hand.
admin.deny_help: Same patterns. These addresses can't sign up at all, and the form says so.
admin.reserved_usernames_help: One per line. Nobody but an admin can sign up with these, or rename themselves to one later. Not case-sensitive. Use * as a wildcard (admin*, *moderator*) or a regular expression between slashes. Works whether or not sign-ups are held for approval.
admin.held_message: Extra text for applicants who are waiting
admin.held_message_help: Added to the 'we've received your application' email. Say what you need from them, for example: reply with your student ID.
admin.declined_message_help: Added to the email sent when you decline someone. Leave it empty for the standard wording.

lib.refused: Sign-ups from this email address aren't accepted on this forum.
lib.username_reserved: That username isn't available. Please choose another.
lib.signin_pending: Your account is waiting for an admin to approve it. We'll email you when it's ready.
lib.signin_declined: This account was not approved, so it can't be used on this forum.
